title: TX queue: sample pop time after acquiring lock
description: Round-3 correctness review found tx_queue_pop() calls get_now_ms() before acquiring queue->lock. A pop blocked behind another operation can pass the packet deadline while waiting, yet expiry and selection use the stale sample and may transmit an expired packet. Move clock sampling under the lock before expiry/selection, return clock errors before mutation, and add a blocked-pop regression test.
acceptance_criteria: A pop delayed across a queued packet deadline expires/drops it and returns EAGAIN rather than transmitting; clock failure leaves state intact; sanitizer-backed host tests pass.
close_reason: Implemented and verified by host sanitizer suite plus review cycle; superseding round-4 findings are tracked separately
